literal: Now, because the four quarters are without dust and the seasons are harmonious and the harvest full, I have again been able to bow before the old tombs, unfold thoughts of boundless grief, feast the elders of former days, and express feelings of remembrance for the distant past.
idiomatic: Now that the realm is at peace and the seasons are harmonious and the harvest abundant, I have again been able to worship at the ancestral tombs, express boundless grief, feast the elders of former days, and voice my longing for those gone before.

literal: Thus in righteousness it joins with one's native place, and in feeling it exceeds even passing through Pei; speaking forever, I am deeply moved—my gratitude and consolation are indeed profound.
idiomatic: Thus my duty to my homeland joins with my affection, and my feeling exceeds even the emotion of passing through Pei; speaking of it ever stirs me, and my gratitude and consolation are profound indeed.

literal: It is fitting forthwith to proclaim benevolence and favor and spread them over all the land.
idiomatic: Let benevolence and favor be proclaimed at once and spread throughout the realm.

literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: A general amnesty is proclaimed.

literal: Restore half of this year's land tax and cloth levy for the migrant households of Dantu county.
idiomatic: Half of this year's land tax and cloth levy for Dantu county's migrant households is remitted.

literal: In the counties through which the journey passes, remit half the land tax.
idiomatic: In the counties along the route, half the land tax is remitted.

literal: The prefects and magistrates at the two-thousand-bushel rank who have all diligently served the royal affairs should receive a share of favor.
idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates who have diligently served the royal cause should receive rewards.

literal: Households of the three battles at Dengcheng and of great generals who died or fell in battle, and the aged, sick, and solitary weak, are all to receive general relief and support.
idiomatic: Households from the three battles at Dengcheng and families of great generals killed or lost in battle, together with the aged, sick, and solitary weak, are to receive general relief.

literal: Send envoys to tour among the common people and inquire into their hardships.
idiomatic: Envoys are sent to tour the districts and inquire into the people's hardships.

literal: The solitary aged, widowers and widows, and those among the six infirmities who cannot support themselves are each to be granted five hu of grain.
idiomatic: The solitary aged, widowers and widows, and those of the six infirmities unable to support themselves are each granted five hu of grain.

literal: " Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of the former Jin Minister of Works, Duke of Loyal Solemnity He Wuji.
idiomatic: " Envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice at the tomb of the former Jin Minister of Works, Duke of Loyal Solemnity He Wuji.

literal: On the yichou day, the tax remissions of the three commanderies of Northern and Southern Pei and Xiapi were proclaimed.
idiomatic: On the yichou day, tax remissions were proclaimed for the three commanderies of Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi.

literal: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been a place of auspicious origin since antiquity and has borne omens in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, within and without it is the flower of the central domain; highways reach it in all four directions and its profit extends to the Huai and sea; its cities and towns are lofty and bright, its local customs pure and uniform; gathering all strategic advantages, it is truly a famous capital.
idiomatic: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been auspicious since antiquity and has borne omens in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, it is the heart of the central domain; highways reach it on every side and its profit extends to the Huai and the sea; its cities are lofty and its customs pure; gathering every strategic advantage, it is truly a famous capital.

literal: Therefore it could illuminate the imperial mind and bring the imperial enterprise to flourishing success.
idiomatic: Therefore it could illuminate the imperial mind and bring the imperial enterprise to success.

literal: In recent years the provincial governors have shifted back and forth and soldiers and civilians have been scattered and displaced; the lanes and dwellings no longer match former days.
idiomatic: In recent years the provincial governors have shifted back and forth and soldiers and civilians have been scattered; the lanes and dwellings no longer match former days.

literal: The old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory weighty among the domains, should be made prosperous and its outward dignity exalted.
idiomatic: As the old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory weighty among the domains, it should be made prosperous and its outward dignity exalted.

literal: Several thousand households willing to relocate from the various provinces may be recruited, given fields and dwellings, and granted remissions."
idiomatic: Several thousand households willing to relocate from the various provinces may be recruited, given fields and dwellings, and granted remissions."

literal: In the fifth month on the bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the fifth month, an edict said: "I was born in this city.

literal: When Lu Xun wreaked havoc, harm flowed through this region.
idiomatic: When Lu Xun wreaked havoc, harm flowed through this region.

literal: The late Emperor, because this was the root of the mulberry homeland and truly shared weal and woe, and because I was still young and undeservedly shared the hardships, our bond of righteousness was close and we endured peril together; traces of old things still remain before my eyes.
idiomatic: The late Emperor, because this was the root of the mulberry homeland and truly shared weal and woe, and because I was still young and undeservedly shared the hardships, our bond of righteousness was close and we endured peril together; traces of old things still remain before my eyes.

literal: The years do not stay; more than three decades have passed, and the people and elders of that time have fallen away with fate.
idiomatic: The years do not stay; more than three decades have passed, and the people and elders of that time have fallen away with fate.

literal: Looking back on what is past, my feeling of deep sighing is doubled.
idiomatic: Looking back on what is past, my feeling of deep sighing is doubled.

literal: Search out civil and military gentlemen of that time, common and official, who still survive today, and report all their names.
idiomatic: Search out civil and military gentlemen of that time, common and official, who still survive today, and report all their names.

literal: If the person himself has died but sons and grandsons survive, favor them generously with gifts."
idiomatic: If the person himself has died but sons and grandsons survive, favor them generously with gifts."

literal: The imperial carriage set out from Dantu by water route; on the renwu day it reached the capital.
idiomatic: The Emperor set out from Dantu by water; on the renwu day he reached the capital.

literal: On the bingxu day, the state of Bapo; on the renchen day, the state of Bada—both sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the state of Bapo; on the renchen day, the state of Bada—both sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the xinwei day, Shao, Prince of Luling and Governor of Jiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province; Dan, Prince of Guangling, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the jiyou day, Hong, Prince of Pingling and General Who Protects the Army, was made Governor of Jiang Province.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Prince of Pingling Hong, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

literal: On the guichou day, Lang, Prince of Nanfeng, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: On the guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, Dan, Prince of Guangling, was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Suixiang.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was reassigned as Prince of Suixiang.

literal: On the jiachen day, Jun, Prince of Shixing and General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was made General Who Campaigns North, with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Shao, Prince of Luling and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made Governor of Yang Province.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Yang Province.

literal: On the xinwei day of the first month in spring of the twenty-seventh year, Jiao and Ning provinces were ordered to grant acting commission seals to commandery and county officials; salaries were to follow central appointment.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the first month in spring of the twenty-seventh year, Jiao and Ning provinces were ordered to grant acting commission seals to commandery and county officials; salaries were to follow central appointment.

literal: On the xinmao day, the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the state of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the xinchou day, Shuo, Prince of Nanping, General of the Right, and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the West.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.

literal: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suolu raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suolu raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.

literal: The Suolu attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, Acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.
idiomatic: The Suolu attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, Acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.

literal: Because of military exigency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one-third.
idiomatic: Because of military exigency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one-third.

literal: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same manner as the inner court officials; thereupon the prefectures and commanderies, and the assistant magistrates and commandants, were all likewise reduced.
idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same manner as the inner court officials; thereupon prefectures and commanderies, and assistant magistrates and commandants, were all likewise reduced.

literal: On the wuyin day, the National University was abolished.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the National University was abolished.

literal: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing, was made General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

literal: In the fourth month of summer on the renzi day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Garrisons the Army.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on the renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Garrisons the Army.

literal: Editorial footnote marker 36 in the source text.
idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 36 in the source text.

literal: In the sixth month on the dingyou day, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
idiomatic: In the sixth month on the dingyou day, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the gengwu day, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, was dispatched on the northern campaign.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on the gengwu day, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, was dispatched on the northern campaign.

literal: Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Grand General, went out and encamped at Pengcheng, commanding all the armies.
idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand General, advanced and encamped at Pengcheng to command all the armies.

literal: On the yihai day, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and fled.
idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and withdrew.

literal: In the intercalary month of winter on the guihai day, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but could not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Qiuyao.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month of winter on the guihai day, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but could not take it; he was defeated by the Suolu and withdrew to Qiuyao.

literal: On the xinwei day, Dan, Prince of Suixiang and Governor of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong city and captured it.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, Governor of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong and captured it.

literal: On the bingxu day, they again captured Tong Pass.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day, they again captured Tong Pass.

literal: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suolu captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was taken.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suolu captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was captured.

literal: On the jiawu day, the troops sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the troops sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.

literal: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left, was killed in battle with the barbarians at the Wei Wu garrison in Shouyang.
idiomatic: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left, was killed in battle with the Suolu at the Wei Wu garrison in Shouyang.

literal: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial law was imposed throughout the court and realm.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial law was imposed throughout the court and realm.

literal: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Cheng, General of Crossbowmen for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were killed in battle with the barbarians at Xuyi.
idiomatic: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Cheng, General of Crossbowmen for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were killed in battle with the Suolu at Xuyi.

literal: On the gengwu day, the Suolu pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the Suolu pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.

literal: On the renwu day, heightened security was ordered throughout the court and realm.
idiomatic: On the renwu day, heightened security was ordered throughout the court and realm.

literal: On the bingxu new moon of the first month in spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy threat there was no court assembly.
idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the first month in spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy threat there was no court assembly.

literal: On the dinghai day, the Suolu withdrew from Guabu.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the Suolu withdrew from Guabu.

literal: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi city.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi.

literal: That month, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, withdrew from Qiuyao and returned to Lixia.
idiomatic: That month, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, withdrew from Qiuyao and returned to Lixia.

literal: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suolu fled in disorder from Xuyi.
idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suolu fled in disorder from Xuyi.

literal: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun are fiercely rampant, bringing hardship to several provinces; speaking of them with concern, I grieve whether waking or sleeping.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun are fiercely rampant, bringing hardship to several provinces; speaking of them with concern, I grieve whether waking or sleeping.

literal: The fierce Jie are wounded and broken; they flee in haste to distant places; the people they have maimed should be restored in timely fashion.
idiomatic: The fierce Jie are wounded and broken; they flee in haste to distant places; the people they have maimed should be restored in timely fashion.

literal: In all commanderies and counties that suffered raids by bandits, order them to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.
idiomatic: In all commanderies and counties that suffered raids, order the people to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.

literal: The spring plowing has just begun; strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.
idiomatic: Spring plowing has just begun; strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.

literal: As to provisions for loans and grants, matters should follow a generous standard.
idiomatic: As to provisions for loans and grants, matters should follow a generous standard.

literal: Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all to be allowed to register where they are and granted remission of taxes and levies."
idiomatic: Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all to be allowed to register where they are and granted remission of taxes and levies."

literal: On the jiaxu day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Grand General, and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand General and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes.

literal: On the xinsi day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Garrisons the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the Northern Center.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Garrisons the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the Northern Center.

literal: On the renwu day, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.
idiomatic: On the renwu day, the Emperor visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.

literal: On the yiyou day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the third month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

literal: On the renchen day, Jun, Prince of Shixing and General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the gengzi day, Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the wushen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Xu Province, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

literal: In the fourth month of summer on the guiyou day, the state of Bada sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on the guiyou day, the state of Bada sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: Shuang, the Suolu pretender General Who Pacifies the South, and Xiu, Secretariat Gentleman of the Suolu, submitted in allegiance.
idiomatic: Shuang, the Suolu pretender General Who Pacifies the South, and Xiu, Secretariat Gentleman of the Suolu, submitted in allegiance.

literal: On the wuyin day, Shuang was made Inspector of Si Province.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Shuang was appointed Inspector of Si Province.

literal: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.

literal: On the dingsi day, the state of Bapo; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—all sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the state of Bapo; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: [37] On the jisi day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and General of Agile Cavalry, took up the governorship of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: [37] On the jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry, took up the governorship of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Zhanzhi, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Zhanzhi, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.

literal: On the renzi day, Dan, Prince of Suixiang and General of the Rear, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the renzi day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, General of the Rear, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.

literal: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Jun, Prince of Wuling and General of the Northern Center, was made Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Fervor and Administrator of Qin commandery, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
idiomatic: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, General of the Northern Center, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Fervor and Administrator of Qin commandery, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

literal: On the jiachen day of the seventh month in autumn, the Eastern barbarian king of Wa, Wajin, was advanced in title to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the seventh month in autumn, the Eastern barbarian king of Wa, Wajin, was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

literal: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.

literal: On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, the state of Koguryo sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, the state of Koguryo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.
idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of Eastern Yan, Western Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.

literal: That winter, displaced persons from Pengcheng were moved to Guabu and those from west of the Huai to Gudu—together about ten thousand households.
idiomatic: That winter, displaced persons from Pengcheng were moved to Guabu and those from west of the Huai to Gudu—together about ten thousand households.

literal: On the jiawu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-ninth year, an edict said: "The six provinces have suffered raids; livelihoods are not yet established, [38] and they have again met with flood disaster; hunger and distress have come one upon another.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-ninth year, an edict said: "The six provinces have suffered raids; livelihoods are not yet established, [38] and they have again met with flood disaster; hunger and distress have come one upon another.

literal: Quickly send orders to the various garrisons to relieve and support them generously.
idiomatic: Quickly send orders to the various garrisons to relieve and support them generously.

literal: Now the agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in using the land's profit.
idiomatic: Now the agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in using the land's profit.

literal: If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."
idiomatic: If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."

literal: On the gengshen day of the second month, the Suolu ruler Tuoba Tao died.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the second month, the Suolu ruler Tuoba Tao died.

literal: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was created Prince of Jian'an.

literal: In the fourth month of summer on the wuwu day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on the wuwu day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
idiomatic: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Ji Province.

literal: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.

literal: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on the bingchen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is full, the body perishes; the barbarian foes follow a constant pattern; the cruel barbarian's extremity of evil has been manifest since old.
idiomatic: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on the bingchen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is full, the body perishes; the barbarian foes follow a constant pattern; the cruel barbarian's extremity of evil has been manifest since old.
